b2-futuro-01.title: Communicative Challenge: How Long Is the Film?
b2-futuro-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos will watch the Mexican film Roma tonight, and he asks how long it is. You do not know, but you guess.
b2-futuro-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that you do not know how long Roma is, and make a guess.
cues: Say that you do not know
b2-futuro-01.target: No sé cuánto dura Roma; durará unas dos horas.
b2-futuro-01.english: I do not know how long Roma is; it probably lasts about two hours.
b2-futuro-01.canDo: I can make a guess about the present or the past with the future and the conditional of probability.

b2-futuro-02.title: Communicative Challenge: After the Boom
b2-futuro-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading about Latin American writers, and she asks what changed after the Boom.
b2-futuro-02.prompt: Tell Meg what changed after the Boom.
cues: Grant a point about the Boom authors
b2-futuro-02.target: Si bien casi todos los autores del Boom eran hombres, hoy muchas escritoras tienen lectores en todo el mundo.
b2-futuro-02.english: Although almost all the Boom authors were men, today many women writers have readers all over the world.
b2-futuro-02.canDo: I can grant a point and then make my own, with *si bien* + indicative.

b2-futuro-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Water and Lithium
b2-futuro-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the salt flats, and he asks what you think should be done.
b2-futuro-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what you think is important when lithium is extracted.
cues: Say what countries should do with water
b2-futuro-03.target: Es importante que los países usen el agua con cuidado cuando extraen litio.
b2-futuro-03.english: It is important that countries use water carefully when they extract lithium.
b2-futuro-03.canDo: I can say what should be done about resources, with *es importante que* and *es necesario que* + subjunctive.

b2-futuro-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Where It Began
b2-futuro-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a documentary about the protests of 2019, and she asks where they began.
b2-futuro-04.prompt: Tell Meg in which country the protests of 2019 began.
b2-futuro-04.target: Chile es el país en el que empezaron las protestas de 2019.
b2-futuro-04.english: Chile is the country in which the 2019 protests began.
b2-futuro-04.canDo: I can describe a movement, a place or a group with *en el que*, *con el que* and other relatives with a preposition.

b2-futuro-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Rhetorical Question
b2-futuro-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are preparing a short talk about Latin American identity, and he asks for a strong sentence to open it.
b2-futuro-05.prompt: Open the talk with a question that makes a point about diversity.
cues: Make the point that the region is diverse
b2-futuro-05.target: ¿Quién puede negar que América Latina es una región muy diversa?
b2-futuro-05.english: Who can deny that Latin America is a very diverse region?
b2-futuro-05.canDo: I can use a metaphor, a rhetorical question or repetition to make a point.

b2-futuro-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Trade Partners
b2-futuro-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are preparing a short talk about trade, and she asks for a point with two sides.
b2-futuro-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg a point with two sides about trade in the region.
cues: Grant that China is the largest partner
Say what the EU and Mercosur did in January 2026
b2-futuro-consolidation.target: Si bien China es hoy el mayor socio comercial de Brasil, Chile y Perú, la Unión Europea y el Mercosur firmaron un acuerdo en enero de 2026.
b2-futuro-consolidation.english: Although China is today the largest trading partner of Brazil, Chile and Peru, the European Union and Mercosur signed an agreement in January 2026.
b2-futuro-consolidation.canDo: I can use probability, *si bien*, value judgments, relatives and rhetorical devices to talk about Latin America today.
